sentences.text:
-------
Vikash Paswan, aged about 22 years, son of Binod Paswan, resident of Mukunda, Itkithakurgaon,
P.O. & P.S. Itki, District Ranchi, Jharkhand-835301.
...... .... Petitioner(s) Versus The State of Jharkhand ..... .... Opp. Party --------
CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH --------
For the Petitioner(s) : Mr. Anup Kr. Agarwal, Advocate For the State : Mr. Ajay Kr. Pathak, A.P. P.
For the Informant : Mr. Dharmendra Kr. Malityar, Advocate --------
02/ Dated 08.09.2025 Heard the parties.

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Itki P.S. Case No. 08 of 2025,
corresponding to G.R. Case No.2074 of 2025, for the offence registered under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of Sri Manoj Kumar Indwar, learned Judicial Magistrate,
Ranchi.
Petitioner is alleged to have raped the victim.
It is also alleged that he video-graphed the entire occurrence.

It was submitted that there is an inordinate delay of about nine months in lodging of the F.I.R.
Learned counsel for the informant has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail.

sentences.text: In view of the submission made above, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly,
the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of Sri Manoj Kumar Indwar, learned Judicial Magistrate, Ranchi, or his successor, in connection with Itki P.S. Case No. 08 of 2025, corresponding to G.R. Case No.2074 of 2025.

(Ambuj Nath, J.) BS/-
